[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born in 1830. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-835|Robert Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1888.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-835]] is assessed at 87% (probable). The held family account identifies Elizabeth Patton (Glasgow) Cunningham as Robert Barclay Glasgow’s child, generally with Phebe McFall. Elizabeth Patton has Faris p 48 and census citations, supporting the compiled child placement.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the child’s earliest household and the cited Faris page or original gravestone parent inscription.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2221 Elizabeth Daton Cunningham]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=== Father relationship: Faris family review — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-835|Robert Barclay Glasgow]] is now assessed at 95% (confident), up from 87% on 22 October 2026. This review supersedes the earlier father grade above.

The printed family list names Elizabeth Patton, born 1830, and her husband William Lowry Cunningham. The distinctive maiden names, year and linked William Cunningham household identify Elizabeth-2221, whose maintained account also cites Faris p. 48 and censuses. The newly inspected page explicitly supplies the paternal family role. The actual Faris pp. 46–47 were visually checked. They explicitly group these children under Robert Barclay Glasgow and Phoebe McFall; Robert’s own dates, two wives and Ohio–Iowa life identify the father account. These exact percentages are subjective assessments of each complete father/profile pair, not statistical measurements.<ref name="FarisRobertChildren1990">David Faris, ''The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio'' (Baltimore: Gateway Press,1990), [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS3J-H9F6-3 printed pp. 46–47], DGS 007834162,image 1583; actual printed pages visually checked 24 October 2026. Retrospective genealogy; original family and census records not inspected. The Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns the previous generation and is not asserted for this child list.</ref>

Page46 does not supply the existing 5 February birth day/month; those fields remain unchanged and are not newly verified. The cited p. 48 and original censuses were not inspected in this batch. This is one retrospective compiled family history. Its list, reported censuses, modern family fields and memorial citations may share evidence; repeated details are not independent proofs. No original birth register, census, Bible or burial record was newly inspected. The 1927 Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns William and Rhoda’s children, not the dates of Robert’s next generation; it is not transferred here. Existing named fathers remain selected. Mothers are separate, ungraded or unselected where previously so. No new parent attachment, merge or live save.
